hero_split.composition_clause: Balanced rule-of-thirds editorial framing with the primary physical subject positioned cleanly in the center-right 55% and uncluttered breathing room around all four edges.

hero_split.blank_surface_guard: All visible screens, panels, walls, and object housings remain completely blank, smooth, and unmarked.

hero_fullbleed_scrim.composition_clause: Wide cinematic asymmetric composition anchoring the focal physical subject strictly inside the right 40% of the frame, while the entire left 55% remains calm, low-detail atmospheric negative space matching the canvas tone for clear visual rest.

hero_fullbleed_scrim.blank_surface_guard: Every architectural surface and foreground material is clean, unmarked, and smooth.

hero_bento_tile.composition_clause: Crisp elevated orthographic product study with the single hero object centered and occupying 68% of the square frame, surrounded by an even quiet matte perimeter margin.

hero_bento_tile.blank_surface_guard: Smooth unmarked industrial finish across every face of the object.

gallery_wide.composition_clause: Wide environmental architectural establishing photograph showing spatial scale, craft workflow, and real physical context across a deep perspective plane.

gallery_wide.blank_surface_guard: Clean architectural surfaces with unmarked fixtures and blank panels.

gallery_detail.composition_clause: Intimate close-up tactile macro study isolating signature raw materials, precision joinery, or surface craftsmanship at 1:2 magnification, offering stark visual contrast to the wide establishing shot.

gallery_detail.blank_surface_guard: Unmarked raw tactile surfaces showcasing pure material craft.

team_portrait.blank_surface_guard: Solid plain seamless studio backdrop and unbranded tailored attire.
